goal: Prevent nodes from continuing to run with damaged state when database reads encounter corruption
Stop treating corrupted records as merely missing keys during coin and index lookups
agreement: Unaddressed objection: aborting in DB reads breaks startup recovery and kills kernel hosts (furszy)
Unaddressed objection: aborting on optional index corruption halts nodes for non-critical errors (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: thread safety of the GUI message box callback before abort is unclear (ajtowns)
Support for removing indirection in the coin view stack (andrewtoth)
Verified with code review and local unit tests (optout21)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because corrupted index records previously caused isolated RPC failures while nodes ran damaged
Failing fast on index corruption prevents nodes from continuing with silently damaged index state

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because deserialization failures in the UTXO database were treated as missing keys rather than errors
Ensuring corrupt coin reads fail safely protects chainstate integrity across validation lookups
